verdict.rationale: Netlify documents that every PR gets a preview URL via Deploy Previews, and a community user independently confirms that its GitHub integration renders a preview build of every PR. The full-stack side is only implied: serverless functions and managed Postgres via Netlify Database exist, but nothing explicitly ties them to per-PR previews. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that previews include backend functions and isolated or branched databases per PR, and documentation of the previews' ephemeral lifecycle and cleanup.
